verdict.rationale: The DGX B200's BMC supports Redfish, IPMI and SNMP, which are standard programmatic management interfaces. The docs also describe node-wide GPU administration software and command-line tools such as nvidia-smi and health checks, so the system can be driven programmatically for management. However, the evidence only mentions these interfaces in a one-line spec listing; there is no NVIDIA-published API reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented NVIDIA API reference (Redfish schema/endpoints, or an API for the GPU management software), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the system through an API.
